questions.prompt: You search for a company in Kube and it doesn't show up under Company, Member, or Lead. What do you do, in order?
questions.modelAnswer: First tick the “Include Archived” checkbox and search again with the magnifying glass. If they still don't appear, click “Add User” to add the company and its primary contact as a member or lead. Once found, click “Create Contract”.
keyPoints: Tick "Include Archived" and search again
Then "Add User" to add the company and primary contact
Click "Create Contract" once found

questions.prompt: What does the Move-in Date control, and why does it matter?
questions.modelAnswer: The Move-in Date controls the proration of the first month's rent and when any booking credits activate. Get it wrong and the first invoice and the member's conference-room credits are both wrong.
keyPoints: Proration of the first month's rent
When booking credits activate

questions.prompt: List the standard settings on the Terms & Company page for term, term type, auto-renew and renewal price.
questions.modelAnswer: Contract Term is 6 or 12 (per the agreement). Term Type is Fixed Term. Auto Renew is On. Renewal Price should default to Custom Pricing with a 4.00% increase.
keyPoints: Term 6 or 12
Fixed Term
Auto Renew On
Custom Pricing with 4.00% increase

questions.prompt: What is the risk with the “Bill Full Contract Cost at Start of Term” option?
questions.modelAnswer: Once it is enabled on an active contract it cannot be disabled through an amendment. The only way back is to terminate the contract and create a new one without the option. So only tick it when the member really must be invoiced for the whole term up front.
keyPoints: Cannot be disabled through an amendment
Must terminate and create a new contract

questions.prompt: After the first Save & Continue, what saves automatically and what doesn't?
questions.modelAnswer: The following pages (Spaces, Amenities, Communicate…) auto-save as you move through them. But any change made back on the Terms & Company page needs Save & Continue clicked again to be saved and applied.
keyPoints: Following pages auto-save
Changes on Terms & Company need Save & Continue again

questions.prompt: Explain the difference between Simple and Custom pricing for a space, and when you'd use Custom.
questions.modelAnswer: Simple pricing sets one price (with optional % or $ discount or increase) for the whole term. Custom pricing lets you add steps by date range — for example one month Free, then the Contract Price for the rest of the term. Use Custom when the agreement has a free period or a price that changes during the term.
keyPoints: Simple = one price for the whole term
Custom = steps by date range (Add Step)
Used for a free period or changing price

questions.prompt: What do you add on the Amenities page, and what is different for the Seattle property?
questions.modelAnswer: Add the “4 Conference Room Hours/Month” booking-credit amenity, then any other monthly amenities or charges from the agreement such as parking, setting quantity with the QTY buttons and price with Simple or Custom pricing. At Seattle skip the booking credits — there are none at that property.
keyPoints: "4 Conference Room Hours/Month" booking credits
Other monthly amenities like parking, with QTY and pricing
Seattle has no booking credits — skip

questions.prompt: Walk through the Manual signing method from the Communicate page to activation.
questions.modelAnswer: Select Manual. Enter notes in the Notes box, use the Default Template, then use Signed Document Upload to upload the hand-signed agreement (it can be downloaded or removed later). Click Email to send the agreement to the member, Download any time for the latest version, then click Activate in the upper-right corner.
keyPoints: Select Manual
Signed Document Upload for the hand-signed agreement
Email to send to the member
Activate in the upper-right corner

questions.prompt: Which communication method can be used to activate a contract right now, and why?
questions.modelAnswer: Manual only, for now. The ySign document template is still in progress, and the Countersign and Activate steps for ySign will be sent once the template is ready and training is complete.
keyPoints: Manual only for now
ySign not ready — template still in progress

questions.prompt: On the Activate screen, what do you do about the charges, and what does it mean if none are listed?
questions.modelAnswer: Check the checkbox to the left of each charge. If no charges are listed, the Move-in Date is after the next Monthly Posting date — Kube will add that month's contract charges automatically then. Update the Creation Date and Due Date if needed, then click Activate Contract and OK.
keyPoints: Check the checkbox next to the charges
No charges = Move-in Date after the next Monthly Posting date
Click Activate Contract then OK

questions.prompt: What is the Due Date on the Activate screen used for?
questions.modelAnswer: The Due Date is when the first automatic payment attempt will be made, provided the company has a payment method on file and auto-pay is enabled.
keyPoints: First automatic payment attempt
Only if payment method on file and auto-pay enabled
